avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Stimulates immune system; may counteract immunosuppressive effects and increase infection risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on infection risk

avoid_supplements.name: Astragalus
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immune-stimulating properties may antagonize TNF-inhibitor therapy and reduce efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; recommend discontinuation before starting infliximab

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce CYP3A4; potential to affect metabolism of concomitant medications; immunomodulatory effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use with caution; monitor for reduced efficacy of concurrent medications

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Live microorganisms; theoretical infection risk in immunocompromised patients, though generally considered safe
caution_supplements.action: Use with monitoring; choose non-pathogenic strains and inform prescriber

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: May support immune regulation; deficiency is common in inflammatory bowel disease patients on infliximab
caution_supplements.action: Monitor levels; supplementation may be beneficial if deficient

avoid_foods.name: Raw/undercooked meats and seafood
avoid_foods.mechanism: Increased infection risk from foodborne pathogens (Listeria, Salmonella, etc.) due to immunosuppression
avoid_foods.action: Strict avoidance required; counsel on proper food handling and cooking temperatures

avoid_foods.name: Unpasteurized dairy products
avoid_foods.mechanism: Risk of Listeria monocytogenes and other pathogens; immunosuppressed patients at high risk for severe infection
avoid_foods.action: Avoid completely; use only pasteurized dairy products

avoid_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
avoid_foods.mechanism: May increase blood pressure and cardiovascular risk; infliximab associated with hypertension in some patients
avoid_foods.action: Limit intake; monitor blood pressure regularly

caution_foods.name: High-fiber foods (if GI sensitivity)
caution_foods.mechanism: May exacerbate GI symptoms in patients with IBD; individual tolerance varies
caution_foods.action: Monitor tolerance; adjust fiber intake based on individual response

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase hepatotoxicity risk and infection susceptibility; moderate use generally acceptable
caution_foods.action: Limit to moderate consumption; avoid excessive intake

monitoring_notes: Infliximab carries a black box warning for serious infections and malignancy; counsel patients to maintain strict food safety practices and avoid live vaccines and immunostimulating supplements. Monitor for signs of infection, tuberculosis screening required, and baseline hepatitis B testing essential due to risk of reactivation.
